shots.camText: Wide profile two-shot · camera at hip height on the pavement · 32 mm · locked-off
shots.line: HELENA: "Sure. Look, I'm just really hungry."
shots.note: Oren left, Helena right; the street vanishes between them; the laundrette window warm behind her.

lines.text: HELENA: Sure. Look, I'm just really hungry.

shots.camText: Close-up of Oren, three-quarters · 85 mm · slow dolly-in (no zoom)
shots.note: His head tilts slightly; his eyes on hers (she is off frame right).

shots.camText: Big close-up of Helena, forehead to chin · 100 mm · handheld at her shoulder
shots.line: HELENA: "Yeah. Haven't eaten properly for a few days."
shots.note: Her face off-centre right, grey space on the left; she looks frame left, to him.

lines.text: HELENA: Yeah. Haven't eaten properly for a few days.

shots.camText: Close-up of her right hand at her side · 65 mm · handheld
shots.line: HELENA (her voice over her hand): "They cut off my benefits, so I can't even —"
shots.note: Her thumb rubs the frayed cuff; when her voice stops, her hand stops.

lines.text: HELENA (over her hand): They cut off my benefits, so I can't even —

shots.camText: Her point of view: insert, looking down at the bag by his left thigh · 50 mm · handheld, nearly still
shots.note: The bag hangs still from his left hand, grease stain toward her; it is never lifted.

shots.camText: Close-up of Helena · 85 mm · handheld at her shoulder
shots.note: Her eyes come back up from the bag to his face; lips pressed, jaw set; then the line.

shots.camText: Medium profile two-shot, waist up · eye level · 40 mm · locked-off, symmetrical
shots.line: OREN: "This belongs to the person I support."
shots.note: Only his eyes drop toward his left hand, then back to hers. The street recedes between them, the laundrette window warm on the right behind her.

lines.text: OREN: This belongs to the person I support.
